Bates County Memorial Rock Star of the Month
item.description: Congratulations to Kate Long, RN, our February Rock Star! Kate works in Outpatient Specialty Clinics, helping patients in the Long-Nissen Infusion Center. She was nominated for this recognition by a coworker for being consistently calm, compassionate, and professional, with a strong bedside manner and dedication to patient advocacy. Thank you, Kate, for your skill and dedication! #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Youth Business Market underway now in Adrian
item.description: The Youth Business Market is well under way today at the Adrian Optimist Building. So much talent under one roof!! Come on out and bring the whole family until 4pm today. They have scrubs, lotions, jewelry, baked goods, 3D printed items, geodes (you can also make into jewelry), tumblers, t-shirts, honey, homemade dog treats, freeze dried fruit and candy, fishing lures, and even decorate your own cupcake or custom make your own scented slime!!Courtesy Byrd's Pecan Delights #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Bates County "Thank a Farmer Week" Focuses on Ronald McDonald Houses
item.description: Celebrate Agriculture: Thank a Farmer Week," held annually the first week of March, expresses gratitude to those who ensure our nation's food, fuel, and fiber security. Across the state, Missouri Farm Bureau members showcase the diversity of agriculture through various acts of service during this week. Organizers say the annual effort is designed to show the impact of agriculture beyond the farm gate. This year, Missouri farmers are marking Thank a Farmer Week by giving back to families in need.
